data.completion_memo: Implemented first: optional DeepSeek hit/miss usage with OpenAI cached-token alias precedence, no double-counting and unknown distinct from zero. Carried text/tool usage through terminal projections, durable spans, auxiliary compaction and independent reviews. Failed/cancelled reviews retain emitted provider usage; cached decisions do not republish billed calls. Run details separates model/review cache metrics and coverage. Final audit added legacy ModelToolEventV1 default plus historical deserialization/projection test. Capability-host full suite passed; focused compatibility tests passed; desktop suite 357 passed/1 ignored; frontend focused suite 10 passed and production frontend build passed. Native isolated upgrade/review fixture and SQLite verification: 9 model usage records (720 cached/180 uncached) and 4 actual reviews (240/160), matching the local provider. UI screenshot inspected at desktop/src-tauri/target/native-approval-cache-1789732599799/verified.png. No live provider hits or dollar savings claimed; historical counters cannot be backfilled.
